goal: Implement bounded pure validation for durable evidence and reconciliation receipts without promoting NOT_PROVEN or inferring unsupported claims.
scope: secret-shaped field and obvious secret-pattern rejection
receipt schema and closed claim-state validation
CLI validation of selected durable receipts and machine-readable reports
out_of_scope: claim promotion, registry mutation, or automatic evidence rewriting
external network, provider, executor, or runtime probes
ECC installation or permanent executor selection
semantic verification of receipt claims beyond bounded consistency checks
architecture_constraints: validation is pure and cannot mutate receipts or registry mappings
PROVEN, PARTIAL, NOT_PROVEN, NOT_SUPPORTED, and UNKNOWN remain distinct
NOT_PROVEN and UNKNOWN are never upgraded by validation
admission remains fail-closed and SOURCE_ID_ASC requires explicit policy
Apex Control Plane owns receipt interpretation; Apex Core ownership is unchanged
acceptance_criteria: valid AC-DEV-019 operational and reconciliation receipts validate against the current registry
secret-shaped keys and obvious secret patterns fail closed
unsupported schema versions, invalid claim states, missing registry sources, and mapping mismatches fail closed
unauthorized admission tie-breaking and boundary violations fail closed
claim promotion from NOT_PROVEN or UNKNOWN requires explicit demonstrated runtime evidence and is never performed by the validator
validation emits deterministic machine-readable results and preserves the input
validation: CLI validation of durable AC-DEV-019 receipts
full Python test suite and documentation validation
backlog/passport/registry JSON validation and git diff --check
